audit.whatIsWrong: Row 6 (2+ items) read Camille in both layers while whys[6] says Vladimir out-sustains her and the win rate is 55.45% to Vladimir. Packet chart has Vladimir there.
audit.why: The page answered '2+ items' two different ways on the same screen.
audit.corrected: phases[6].side and win[6] flipped to Vladimir as a matched pair, rating 5/10 to 6/10, phases[6].why rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every instruction hung on 'Hookshot's cooldown' and 'a long cooldown' without a single number, exactly the gap the mirror audit recorded.
audit.why: Hookshot 16/15/14/13/12, The Hextech Ultimatum 140/115/90, Precision Protocol 9s, Sanguine Pool 28s, Hemoplague 120s. Without those the reader cannot plan a window.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into phases[2], phases[3], phases[4], spikes[1] and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Adaptive Defenses was never mentioned, Precision Protocol's auto reset was never flagged as the burst tell, Tactical Sweep's healing was never tied to anti-heal, Hookshot's wall requirement was stated only as 'don't fight near walls' with no reason, and the ultimate was called 'Hextech Ultimatum' — the real name is The Hextech Ultimatum.
audit.why: Adaptive Defenses shields her against the damage type that just hit her, so poking a Camille with Transfusion feeds her a magic shield — you want burst, not chip. Precision Protocol's second cast carries the true damage, so the wind-up is the cue. Tactical Sweep's outer half heals her, which is what makes Grievous Wounds core here.
audit.corrected: Passive shield, the Q reset tell, the wall requirement and the anti-heal trigger all written in; ultimate given its real name.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Camille carry threat 9/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: Crimson Pact health and Hemoplague outlast her single-target burst. Close it before the map decides.

edits.before: Q-drain on cooldown — you trade HP like a loan shark. Identify how Camille contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Level 1 is even, but her passive shields against whichever damage type hit her — your Q hands her a magic shield each time.

edits.before: Pool answers his single biggest button — save it for exactly that. Only take the trade when Camille's Hookshot is down.
edits.after: Precision Protocol is an auto reset: the wind-up is your cue to step back, and the second cast is the true-damage one.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Camille must walk into your range.
edits.after: Hookshot needs a wall to pull from — hold the open lane centre, and it is 16s at rank 1 before she can try again.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Hookshot's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Trade inside Hookshot's 16s gap and bank small leads. Buy anti-heal: Tactical Sweep's outer half heals her every time it lands.

edits.before: Hemoplague + empowered Q turns mid-game fights into resets. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Camille's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: The Hextech Ultimatum is 140s at rank 1 and anchors you in place. Pool dodges the autos inside it; Hemoplague is your 120s answer.

edits.before: - Camille Hookshot: matchup-defining — Her engage/stun. Pool after it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Hookshot: 16s, needs a wall and knocks up on landing — stay off walls. - The Hextech Ultimatum: 140s, anchors you. - Precision Protocol: 9s reset; the second cast is the true damage. - Sanguine Pool: 28s. - Hemoplague: 120s.

edits.before: Track Camille's Hookshot: Her engage/stun. Pool after it. When it is down — Q-E + R her.
edits.after: Adaptive Defenses shields her against magic the moment you Q — burst her, do not chip her.

edits.before: Level 6 stays hers — Hextech Ultimatum isolates you for a full combo.
edits.after: Level 6 stays hers — The Hextech Ultimatum anchors you for the combo.

edits.before: Camille's level-2 Precision Protocol plus Hookshot spikes hard: she engages, true-damages a chunk of your bar and Tactical Sweep slows you so you can't kite; save Pool for her second Q auto, not the first.
edits.after: Camille's level-2 Precision Protocol plus Hookshot spikes hard: she engages, true-damages a chunk of your bar, and Tactical Sweep slows you while healing her off the outer half; Pool her second Q, not the first.

edits.before: The Hextech Ultimatum ult isolates you and blocks your retreat; Pool while it's active to dodge her Q autos, but she's still favoured through her all-in windows.
edits.after: The Hextech Ultimatum, 140s at rank 1, anchors you in a zone while her autos add bonus magic damage; Pool that sequence, but she stays favoured through her all-in windows.

edits.before: Level 1 is even — trade Transfusion for her autos and neither commits before she has Hookshot. Zone her from CS and don't get caught in wall range.
edits.after: Level 1 is even, but every auto gives her a shield against your damage type; zone her off CS, never stand in wall range, and don't chip into that shield.

edits.before: From 2 through 6 Camille holds the edge: her engage, true damage and Ultimatum lock you down. Play safe, Pool her second Q, and ward against her all-in.
edits.after: From 2 through 6 Camille holds the edge: Hookshot, true damage and the anchor. Charge Tides behind your casters — enemy units block it — and Pool her second Q.

edits.before: Isolate you with Hextech Ultimatum for a full combo
edits.after: Anchor you with The Hextech Ultimatum for a combo

notes: The packet suspectName was a real error: the ability is 'The Hextech Ultimatum'. wants.you[1] and spikes[2] still say 'Ultimatum' bare, which is acceptable shorthand once the full name appears. Whether Sanguine Pool's untargetability breaks the R anchor is not in Riot's text and I did not assert it either way.
